about_short_description.short_description: Downtobid provides a platform for subcontractors and vendors to manage and track construction bids in one workspace.

product.name: Downtobid ITB Tool
product.description: A platform for general contractors to create and send personalized Invitations to Bid (ITBs) to qualified subcontractors, automating bid package creation and subcontractor matching.

product.name: Bid Board
product.description: A bid tracking dashboard for subcontractors and material vendors that automatically imports and organizes bid invitations from email, tracking deadlines and communications without manual data entry.

product.name: Downtobid Subcontractor Database (Downtobid Network)
product.description: A verified and regularly updated database of subcontractors categorized by trade and location, used to provide tailored subcontractor lists for bid invitations.

product.name: AI Notebook
product.description: An AI-powered tool that reads and analyzes construction plans to summarize key information, track changes between versions, and generate reports to assist estimators and contractors.

product.name: Planroom
product.description: A centralized, AI-driven digital planroom that organizes project documents by category and allows subcontractors to access bid documents without needing an account.
